description: Companies in the JobSlop index with their listing counts. Filter by name and sort by size or by how many listings are ghost-flagged.

industry.description: Only companies tagged with this industry: technology, finance, media, logistics. Untagged companies are left out when set.

min_jobs.description: Leave out companies with fewer listings (useful with ghost_share).

offset.description: Results to skip, for paging. Use next_offset from the previous page.

query.description: Text the company name must contain.

name: jobslop_list_companies
title: List companies
